name: Question 1
problem:
Solve the initial value problem

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}3 & 4 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}]x(t),\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

*Hint: The only eigenvalue of the system's matrix is $\lambda =1.$*

Question 1
?

Solve the initial value problem x′(t)=[34−1−1]x(t),x(0)=[−11]. Hint: The only eigenvalue of the system's matrix is λ=1.

a
 [−etet]
b
 [(2t−1)et(1−t)et]
c
 [(t+1)et(1+2t)et]
d
[(2t+1)etet]
e
[−et(1−t)et]
